summary: Ansible 12 overhauls templating and adds Data Tagging, which surfaces previously undetected problems; some breaking changes were unavoidable, so test playbooks in staging first.
questions: What are the big changes in Ansible 12 / ansible-core 2.19?
Will upgrading to ansible-core 2.19 break my playbooks?
What is Data Tagging in Ansible?
How should I test before moving to Ansible 12?

answer_card.title: What changed in Ansible 12 and how to prepare
answer_card.answer_md:
Ansible 12 (ansible-core 2.19) brings a **templating engine overhaul** and a new feature called **Data Tagging**. Together they report many problematic behaviors that used to go unnoticed, improving security, performance and user experience.

Backward compatibility was kept where practical, but some breaking changes were necessary. Test your playbooks and roles in a **staging environment** with this release before rolling it out.
